heading.title: Of the Powers of an Executor or Administrator

article.title: Commission or agency charges.
article.content: An executor or administrator shall not be entitled to receive or retain any commission or agency charges at a higher rate than that for the time being fixed in respect of the Administrator-General by or under the Administrator-General’s Act, 1913 (3 of 1913).
article.html:
309Commission or agency charges.

Section 309 · Part IX · Chapter VI · page 83 of the Act

An executor or administrator shall not be entitled to receive or retain any commission or agency charges at a higher rate than that for the time being fixed in respect of the Administrator-General by or under the Administrator-General’s Act, 1913 (3 of 1913).
